text: All API requests must supply an OAuth 2.0 Bearer token in the Authorization header. Bearer tokens have a strict TTL of 3600 seconds (1 hour). Refresh tokens remain valid for 30 days and must be rotated upon each refresh invocation. Any token with an expired timestamp immediately returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized with error code TOKEN_EXPIRED.

Production tier accounts are allocated a maximum of 10,000 requests per minute with a burst concurrency limit of 250 requests. If the rate limit is exceeded, the gateway issues HTTP 429 Too Many Requests alongside a Retry-After header indicating backoff in seconds. Sandbox tiers are throttled to 60 requests per minute.

Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of delivery if the merchandise is unopened in original packaging. Software licenses and downloadable media are non-refundable once the activation key has been viewed or generated. Expedited shipping fees are non-refundable under all circumstances.

Hardware reported defective within 90 days of purchase qualifies for advance RMA replacement. The merchant covers return shipping costs via a prepaid label. Replacements ship via 2-day priority freight within 24 hours of receiving the RMA tracking confirmation.

The platform utilizes a Redis cluster deployed in a multi-AZ read-replica setup. Cache invalidation follows a Cache-Aside pattern with event-driven change data capture via Debezium. When a database record updates, invalidation events purge corresponding cache keys within a p99 SLA of 85 milliseconds.

PostgreSQL databases operate with synchronous streaming replication. In the event of primary node failure, AWS Aurora performs automatic failover to the replica within 30 to 60 seconds. The application pool automatically reconnects via DNS endpoint routing without requiring container restart.

document_title: Data Governance, PII Scrubbing & Retention Schedule
text: Customer transactional logs are retained for exactly 7 years to satisfy financial audit compliance. PII fields including credit card numbers and social security numbers are tokenized at ingestion and permanently deleted from analytical data warehouses after 90 days.

All persistent disk storage is encrypted at rest using AES-256 via AWS KMS customer-managed keys (CMK). Cryptographic keys are rotated automatically every 365 days. Data in transit requires TLS 1.3 encryption across all public and inter-service VPC endpoints.

document_title: AI Model Safety & Hallucination Quality Gates
text: Production LLM applications must pass automated evaluation before deployment. The release quality gate mandates a minimum factual precision of 0.85 and a maximum hallucination rate of 0.05 on held-out gold test sets. Models exceeding a p95 inference latency of 800ms are barred from production.

Human preference annotations require a minimum of 3 independent annotators per prompt. Pairwise preference data is filtered using consensus voting; pairs with less than 66% annotator agreement are routed to SME adjudication before ingestion into DPO alignment pipelines.
